answer: Give every agent identity a living trellis to tend: a real, geotagged community garden plot, inspected each season by two neighboring plot-holders who sign off on the work. A vine left untended dies back within weeks, so an identity that stops showing up withers on its own, and reviving it costs a fresh inspection plus a new season of labor. Faking one plot is easy, but faking a hundred means renting a hundred plots, buying tools, and paying a hundred inspection fees, while a single marble marker at each gate records who tended what and when. Sybils cannot scale a garden.
